roadmap.title: Establish a base and explore
roadmap.description: Start on Normal for a safer introduction, or Permadeath if you want to use one save. Claim a base, unlock the Space Anomaly and collect early milestones. Talk to new inhabitants and learn words as you travel.

roadmap.title: Finish the exploration milestones
roadmap.description: On the same save, finish the wallet, conversation, language, walking, space-combat and warp totals. Complete animal surveys on ten planets and claim each fauna bonus.

roadmap.title: Accumulate extreme-weather time
roadmap.description: Spend time outdoors on extreme-weather planets while keeping your suit supplied. Check the Extreme Survival counter to confirm the weather is giving credit.

roadmap.title: Complete a Permadeath galaxy transition
roadmap.description: If your exploration save uses Normal, start a separate Permadeath save. Keep the Permadeath preset and complete the Artemis reset ending to earn both mode-specific achievements. A separate Survival completion is optional.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Naturalist’ status in Planet Zoology Scanned
achievements.summary: Complete the animal-species survey of one planet.

steps.text: Choose a planet with a small fauna roster; exotic worlds can have only one species. Use your @item{Analysis Visor} to scan every animal species listed for that planet.
Open @mechanic{Discoveries}, select the planet and open @mechanic{Fauna}. Claim the all-fauna completion bonus.

achievements.summary: Make 5 hyperdrive jumps between star systems.

guide.context: You can revisit the same systems. Teleporters and planetary portals do not advance this counter.

steps.text: Follow @mechanic{Awakenings} until your starship has a working Hyperdrive and the Warp Cell blueprint.
Refuel the @item{Hyperdrive} with Warp Cells. Use the @mechanic{Galaxy Map} to warp between star systems until you have made 5 jumps.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Entrepreneur’ status in Most Units Accrued
achievements.summary: Reach the Entrepreneur milestone for the highest number of Units held at once.

steps.text: Sell spare exploration valuables at a space-station trade terminal. Keep saving until you hold @item{250,000 Units}.

achievements.summary: Learn 10 alien words.

steps.text: Ask Gek, Korvax and Vy'keen inhabitants to teach you words, or activate @mechanic{Knowledge Stones} on planets, until your total reaches 10.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Known’ status in Alien Colonist Encounters
achievements.summary: Start conversations with 10 different alien inhabitants.

guide.context: Each alien counts only on the first meeting. Shopkeepers, Nada and Polo do not count.

steps.text: Talk to ordinary @npc{Gek}, @npc{Korvax} and @npc{Vy'keen} inhabitants at space stations until you have met 10 different aliens.

achievements.summary: Destroy 5 starships.

guide.context: Ground Sentinel kills advance a different statistic.

steps.text: Defeat pirate ships in space encounters until you have destroyed 5 starships.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Archivist’ status in Planet Zoology Scanned
achievements.summary: Complete the animal-species surveys of 7 different planets on one save.

steps.text: Choose a planet with a small fauna roster; exotic worlds can have only one species. Use your @item{Analysis Visor} to scan every animal species listed for that planet.
Open @mechanic{Discoveries}, select the planet and open @mechanic{Fauna}. Claim the all-fauna completion bonus. Finish and claim surveys on 7 different planets in total.

achievements.summary: Make 40 hyperdrive jumps between star systems.

guide.context: You can revisit the same systems. Teleporters and planetary portals do not advance this counter.

steps.text: Refuel the @item{Hyperdrive} with Warp Cells. Use the @mechanic{Galaxy Map} to warp between star systems until you have made 40 jumps.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Trader’ status in Most Units Accrued
achievements.summary: Hold 1,000,000 Units at one time.

steps.text: Sell spare exploration valuables at space-station trade terminals. Save the proceeds until your wallet reaches @item{1,000,000 Units}.

achievements.summary: Learn 50 alien words.

steps.text: Ask Gek, Korvax and Vy'keen inhabitants to teach you words, or activate @mechanic{Knowledge Stones} on planets, until your total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Diplomat’ status in Alien Colonist Encounters
achievements.summary: Start conversations with 50 different alien inhabitants.

guide.context: Each alien counts only on the first meeting. Shopkeepers, Nada and Polo do not count.

steps.text: Talk to ordinary @npc{Gek}, @npc{Korvax} and @npc{Vy'keen} inhabitants at space stations until you have met 50 different aliens.

achievements.summary: Destroy 50 starships.

guide.context: Ground Sentinel kills advance a different statistic.

steps.text: Upgrade your ship's weapons and shields, then fight pirate encounters until your destroyed-starship total reaches 50.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 30 sols of Extreme Survival time on one save.

guide.context: The timer is cumulative. Credit pauses in your starship, while the game is paused, or when the weather is safe. High Sentinel activity alone does not qualify.

steps.text: Land on an extreme-weather planet. Check for @warn{Extreme} above the Hazard Protection bar and confirm that the weather drains your protection.
Stay outdoors in qualifying weather and recharge Hazard Protection and Life Support as needed. Accumulate 27,000 displayed in-game minutes in the @mechanic{Extreme Survival} milestone.

achievements.summary: Travel 40,000u on foot.

guide.context: Jetpack travel and vehicle travel do not add to this distance.

steps.text: Walk or run while exploring until your @mechanic{On-foot Exploration} distance reaches 40,000u.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Encyclopedia’ status in Planet Zoology Scanned
achievements.summary: Complete the animal-species surveys of 10 different planets on one save.

steps.text: Choose a planet with a small fauna roster; exotic worlds can have only one species. Use your @item{Analysis Visor} to scan every animal species listed for that planet.
Open @mechanic{Discoveries}, select the planet and open @mechanic{Fauna}. Claim the all-fauna completion bonus. Finish and claim surveys on 10 different planets in total.

steps.text: Refuel the @item{Hyperdrive} with Warp Cells. Use the @mechanic{Galaxy Map} to warp between star systems until you have made 75 jumps.

achievements.summary: Hold 2,000,000 Units at one time.

steps.text: Sell spare exploration valuables at space-station trade terminals. Save the proceeds until your wallet reaches @item{2,000,000 Units}.

achievements.summary: Learn 150 alien words.

steps.text: Ask Gek, Korvax and Vy'keen inhabitants to teach you words, or activate @mechanic{Knowledge Stones} on planets, until your total reaches 150.

achievements.description: Attain ‘Ambassador’ status in Alien Colonist Encounters
achievements.summary: Start conversations with 80 different alien inhabitants.

guide.context: Each alien counts only on the first meeting. Shopkeepers, Nada and Polo do not count.

steps.text: Talk to ordinary @npc{Gek}, @npc{Korvax} and @npc{Vy'keen} inhabitants at space stations until you have met 80 different aliens.

achievements.summary: Destroy 80 starships.

guide.context: Ground Sentinel kills advance a different statistic.

steps.text: Upgrade your ship's weapons and shields, then fight pirate encounters until your destroyed-starship total reaches 80.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 48 sols of Extreme Survival time on one save.

guide.context: The timer is cumulative. Credit pauses in your starship, while the game is paused, or when the weather is safe. High Sentinel activity alone does not qualify.

steps.text: Land on an extreme-weather planet. Check for @warn{Extreme} above the Hazard Protection bar and confirm that the weather drains your protection.
Stay outdoors in qualifying weather and recharge Hazard Protection and Life Support as needed. Accumulate 43,200 displayed in-game minutes in the @mechanic{Extreme Survival} milestone.

achievements.summary: Travel 100,000u on foot.

guide.context: Jetpack travel and vehicle travel do not add to this distance.

steps.text: Walk or run while exploring until your @mechanic{On-foot Exploration} distance reaches 100,000u.

achievements.description: Claim a Base or Buy a Freighter
achievements.summary: Claim a planetary base or purchase a freighter.

steps.text: Follow the early base-building tutorial. Place a @item{Base Computer}, access the computer and claim the site.

achievements.summary: Build an Exocraft.

steps.text: In the research room aboard the @loc{Space Anomaly}, spend @item{Salvaged Data} to unlock the @item{Roamer Geobay} blueprint.
Build a @item{Roamer Geobay} on a planet to create your Roamer Exocraft.

achievements.summary: Visit another player's base and access its Base Computer.

steps.text: While connected online, use the large teleporter aboard the @loc{Space Anomaly}. Select a base belonging to another player and travel there.
Find that base's @item{Base Computer} and open it as a guest.

achievements.description: Reach the Centre of the Galaxy in Survival Mode
achievements.summary: Reach the galactic centre or complete the Artemis galaxy reset in Survival or Permadeath mode.

guide.context: A Permadeath completion also awards this Survival achievement, so a separate Survival run is optional.

steps.text: Start a new save with the @mechanic{Survival} preset. Keep that preset's difficulty settings throughout the run.
Follow the @mechanic{Artemis} storyline through to @mechanic{The Purge}. Complete the 16 required warps, then charge and enter the marked portal.
At the final @mechanic{Atlas Interface}, select @mechanic{Cry out} six times to reach the final choice.
Choose @mechanic{Reset Simulation}, then select a galaxy type. Let the transition to the new galaxy finish.

achievements.description: Reach the Centre of the Galaxy in Permadeath Mode
achievements.summary: Reach the galactic centre or complete the Artemis galaxy reset in Permadeath mode.

guide.context: Death deletes a Permadeath save. This completion also awards Take a Deep Breath. Carry Hazard Protection and Life Support supplies before exploring.

steps.text: Start a new save with the @mechanic{Permadeath} preset. Keep that preset's difficulty settings throughout the run.
Follow the @mechanic{Artemis} storyline through to @mechanic{The Purge}. Complete the 16 required warps, then charge and enter the marked portal.
At the final @mechanic{Atlas Interface}, select @mechanic{Cry out} six times to reach the final choice.
Choose @mechanic{Reset Simulation}, then select a galaxy type. Let the transition to the new galaxy finish.
